lead: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was a politician, born on 31 October 1875 in Nadiad.
He died on 15 December 1950 in Mumbai at the age of 75.
He has held the office of Deputy Prime Minister of India and Minister of Home Affairs and has been recognised with the Bharat Ratna.
Below you will find a verified overview of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was born on 31 October 1875 in Nadiad, and holds citizenship of British Raj, India and Dominion of India.
His listed education includes Middle Temple and City Law School.
He is recorded as speaking Gujarati and English.

sections.heading: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel — Career and Professional Work
paras: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel works primarily as a politician, economist, barrister, jurist and freedom fighter.

He has held the following offices: Deputy Prime Minister of India (1947–6767), Minister of Home Affairs (1948–1950), Member of the Lok Sabha, Member of the Constituent Assembly of India (1946–1950), member of the Negotiating Committee of the Constituent Assembly of India (1946–present) and member of the Steering Committee of the Constituent Assembly of India (1947–present). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
